title: Wilson's four marriages
summary: Wilson lists marriages to Irene Armstrong, Janice, Blanche and Joanne Roberts Gidney, with dates and where he met each.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: This is January 4th, 1980, and we're continuing this from last night. You've been busy, you're getting ready to move out of Boston here, and I thought we'd just talk about something we said last night, have a little rundown because I'm sure people would be interested in knowing part of your genealogy, your family and whatnot. You mentioned your first marriage to Irene, and there were no children involved. And would you like to take it on from there, and the years and whatnot?

Yeah, I believe Irene and I got married -- her full name was Irene Armstrong. She had been married to Joe Eady, who was a popular nightclub operator on the South Side of Chicago in those days. And I guess Irene and I stayed together until maybe 1937 and we separated and finally divorced. And Irene, I guess during the '40s, married a man out in Cleveland. (Kitchings)
And then in 1945 I married Janice Karate (PHONETIC) from New York City, she was born and raised in New York City.
Where did you meet her, Teddy?
I met Janice, I believe, at the Cafe Society when I was playing there. The Cafe Society downtown
in New York, during the second World War. And she and I got married in 1944, I believe we got married, or 1945. I met her in 1944, I think we got married in 1945, and then my oldest son, Theodore --
Your oldest son, Theodore, was born of that marriage, right, Teddy?

Yes, he was born in 1946. And, let's see, I think the marriage broke up about 1955 or '56. Got divorced and I got remarried, let's see, I married a young lady who was working for the London House in those days, doing promotions, record promotions for London House. Her name was Blanche Loft. She's originally from Massachusetts, around the Adams-Pittsfield area, she was working for London House, and we got married. And we had a son born in 1958. I guess we got married in 1957, and my son Steven, S-t-e-v-e-n, he was born in 1958.

And then, unfortunately, that marriage finished, and then I met my next wife, who is my present wife, Joanne Roberts, her maiden name was. By that time she was Joanne Gidney from Cleveland, Ohio. She'd previously been married to an excellent pianist in Cleveland, Bill Gidney. And let's see, after about three years I was separated from Blanche, Bunny, we call her, Blanche Flower, in 1960, and then married Joanne Roberts Gidney in 1963. And we have two children of
